title: About Callsun
seoTitle: About Callsun | B2B Solar Modules & Storage System Supplier
metaDescription: Learn how Callsun supports distributors, dealers and EPC installers with solar modules, grid-tied and off-grid system packages, certification documents and project references.
h1: A solar supply partner built for distributors, dealers and EPC installers.

hero.description: Callsun focuses on solar modules, standard system packages and project references that help B2B partners quote faster, explain system value and convert more qualified inquiries.
hero.imageAlt: Callsun solar module and storage package illustration

intro.title: From product supply to sales enablement.
intro.description: Callsun is positioned as a practical B2B solar partner, not just a catalog website. The site structure, downloadable resources and inquiry flows are designed around how distributors, dealers and EPC installers evaluate suppliers.

cards.title: Product-ready supply
cards.description: Standard and custom solar modules are organized with specifications, certifications, applications and downloads so sales teams can respond with fewer back-and-forth questions.

cards.title: System package thinking
cards.description: Grid-tied and off-grid packages connect modules, batteries, inverters and accessories into repeatable solutions that are easier for partners to explain and quote.

cards.title: Inquiry-first operation
cards.description: SEO pages, SEM landing pages, RFQ forms and tracking fields are prepared to support lead generation, campaign attribution and later CRM integration.

strengths.title: The proof points buyers expect before they ask for pricing.
strengths.description: Use this section to keep company strength, quality controls and channel support editable as the customer provides official factory photos, certificates and partner materials.

items.title: Module portfolio
items.description: Standard 450W, 580W and 620W modules plus compact custom modules for non-standard scenarios such as RV, balcony, off-grid and project-specific requirements.

items.title: Packaged solutions
items.description: Pre-structured grid-tied and off-grid solar-plus-storage packages help partners move from single component comparison to complete system discussions.

items.title: Document support
items.description: Datasheets, certificates, product catalogs, installation guides and warranty materials are managed through the CMS download center.

items.title: Project references
items.description: Commercial rooftop, retail, industrial and solar-plus-storage cases can be used as sales proof for distributors and EPC installers.

certifications.title: Make compliance evidence easy to find.
certifications.description: Certification files are currently placeholder records. Replace them with official UL, IEC, warranty and test documents when the customer provides final PDFs.

partners.title: Built around distributor and installer workflows.
partners.description: Callsun's website should help partners validate product fit, compare packages, collect documents and send project requirements before a sales call.

items.title: For distributors
items.description: Clear product categories, datasheets, certification references and inquiry forms for faster wholesale conversations.

items.title: For dealers
items.description: Application pages, FAQ and sales-oriented case details support end-customer explanation.

items.title: For EPC installers
items.description: System topology, BOM cards, project parameters and technical support pages reduce pre-sales friction.

timeline.label: Product foundation
timeline.description: Solar module portfolio, datasheets and certification materials become the base layer for B2B search traffic.

timeline.label: System package layer
timeline.description: Grid-tied and off-grid packages connect components into repeatable offers for project quoting.

timeline.label: SEO / SEM growth layer
timeline.description: Custom pages, landing pages, blog content and tracking fields support ongoing acquisition campaigns.

finalCta.title: Want to evaluate Callsun as a supply partner?
finalCta.description: Send your target module type, system capacity, market and timeline. The Callsun team can respond with product options, package references and next-step documents.
